messages:
Rhea (Hiring Manager): Heads up \u2014 Maya (PM) starts Wed 9am PT. Can someone drop a neat one-pager manager checklist + a short 30/60/90 I can paste into the welcome email?
Omar (People Ops): Will do. Keep it minimal for the offer email. Include manager commitments?
Rhea (Hiring Manager): Yes: weekly 1:1, a first-week micro-deliverable, and 30/60/90 checkpoints. Also a tiny who-to-ask list.
Jin (IT): From IT: confirm mac vs linux, need AWS console? We normally image 48hrs prior. If calendar invites don't go through open @it-help with a screenshot. If laptop delayed use cloud devbox: https://devbox.redwood.internal (temp token request @it-help).
Priya (Buddy): I'll be buddy. Can do a 30m team intro and 1:1 shadow on Day 3. I'll post a welcome template for the channel.
Omar (People Ops): MANAGER ONE-PAGER (pasteable)
- Pre-boarding (Day -3 to -1): Confirm laptop type & shipping, add personal email for calendar invites, add to core Slack channels (#product, #pm-offtopic).
- Day 1 AM: 9:00 welcome w/manager (15m), team intro (30m), IT check (15m), lunch with buddy.
- Day 1 PM: HR benefits (20m), enable Okta/MFA, repo read access, assign 1-week mini deliverable (1-page problem statement).
- Days 2-4: Product demos, customer context, shadow cross-functional partners.
- Day 5: Recap with manager & schedule 30/60/90 draft review.

Omar (People Ops): WHO TO ASK
- IT: @it-help \u2014 laptop & credentials
- Security: @security_ops \u2014 SSO/MFA
- Payroll/Benefits: @people-ops \u2014 paperwork
- Buddy: @Priya \u2014 day-to-day questions

Omar (People Ops): 30/60/90 (one-line prompts)
- 30 days: "Onboarded with read access to core systems, shipped a scoped onboarding task, met key stakeholders."
- 60 days: "Owns a small feature/experiment, shows measurable progress on KPIs, embedded with cross-functional partners."
- 90 days: "Delivers measurable impact tied to OKRs, independently runs planning & demos, improves a process or doc."

Jin (IT): Note: staging view access by Day 2; deploy rights after manager + security signoff (usually < 1 week). If immediate deploy needed, request temporary token via @it-help.

Priya (Buddy): Channel intro template: "Welcome @Maya! Maya joins as PM Wed 9am PT. Buddy: @Priya. Quick intro 9:30am then lunch. Post any helpful docs here." :tada:

Maya (New hire): Thanks team! Quick Q: will I get analytics & bug tracker access Day 1?
Jin (IT): View access to analytics & tracker by Day 2. If you need Day 1, open @it-help and cc Rhea.

Rhea (Hiring Manager): Great. Omar, last thing: can you paste a one-line offer blurb I can use?

Omar (People Ops): Offer blurb: "Welcome to Redwood! Attached is a short first-week agenda and a starter 30/60/90. We'll provision accounts before Day 1; for setup help contact @it-help. Your buddy @Priya will meet you for lunch on Day 1. Excited to have you!"

Rhea (Hiring Manager): Perfect \u2014 sending now. Thanks all :rocket:
